task_completion.description: Log in to the Nx Witness VMS Web Admin interface
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the Nx Witness login page followed by the main dashboard or settings menu, showing the user is authenticated as 'admin'.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the System Settings or Security configuration section
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent clicking on 'Settings', 'System Settings', or 'Security' tabs within the web interface.

task_completion.description: Set sessionLimitMinutes to 15 and disable autoDiscoveryEnabled
task_completion.visual_evidence: A settings page showing a numeric input for session timeout set to '15' and a toggle or checkbox for 'Auto Discovery' in the OFF/unchecked position.

task_completion.description: Force traffic encryption and disable statistics collection
task_completion.visual_evidence: A toggle for 'Force Traffic Encryption' (or similar) set to ON/checked, and 'Allow Statistics' or 'Anonymous Usage' set to OFF/unchecked.
A checkbox or toggle for 'Insecure Deprecated API' or 'Legacy API' set to the OFF/disabled state.

task_completion.description: Create the security hardening report at the specified path
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal window or text editor showing the creation/saving of a file at '/home/ga/security_hardening_report.txt' containing a list of the five changes.

integrity.description: Verify the agent used the Web UI for configuration rather than just CLI scripts
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the browser interacting with https://localhost:7001 and clicking UI elements, not just a terminal executing curl commands.

integrity.description: Verify the agent clicked 'Save' or 'Apply' after changing settings
integrity.visual_evidence: A screenshot showing the 'Save' button being clicked or a 'Settings saved' confirmation message appearing in the UI.

integrity.description: Verify the report was typed or generated based on the session, not pre-existing
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent should be seen opening a text editor or using a 'echo' command to write the specific values configured during the session.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Nx Witness VMS is hosted at https://localhost:7001. Credentials are admin / Admin1234!. The five specific settings to verify in the UI are: sessionLimitMinutes (15), autoDiscoveryEnabled (false), trafficEncryptionForced (true), statisticsAllowed (false), and insecureDeprecatedApiEnabled (false). The final report must be located exactly at /home/ga/security_hardening_report.txt.
